propositions: Core must compare only canonical local-vocabulary shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads at emission/ingestion boundaries via port calls.

All package-root reconciler modules must have zero direct imports of adapters.jira, acli_subprocess, lazy-key literals, or by-path loads of vendor sibling modules (single exemption: inbound_fields.py).

Outbound field and link differs must canonicalize fetched snapshots via InboundMapper and build vendor payloads exclusively via injected OutboundMapper at emission, with vendor comparison helpers relocated to adapter internals.

Remaining open children must route the scalar port surface (project/query_project/assert_env_ready/neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError), absence probe mechanics, rich-text codec, and comment-limit paths through the Backend port to achieve vendor neutrality.
All src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py modules must respect the 800-LOC module-size gate and pass full behavior-preserving test coverage and type checking.
